lessons_used: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted results, while zero or negative forecasts repeatedly preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.8% and -9.0%).
Choose path copy updates (choose_path, copy) hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).

Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) delivered inconsistent results with strong wins (+2.5% to +6.7%) alongside severe losses (-4.5% to -9.5%), while story stage redesigns (choose_path, redesign) had 3 wins alongside 2 losses.
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 7 tests despite 2 wins (+3.6% and +6.5%), and categories with fewer agreeing tests remain thin evidence.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Full Bleed Layout
candidates.change: Redesign adoption certificate screen to a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing pet certificate details.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8% with high mean duration (1017s); a streamlined full-bleed showcase improves visual clarity.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen layout while preserving its core function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage has 21.2% drop-off; redesigns show slight average positive lift (+0.6%) but inconsistent results.

candidates.title: Path Companion Overview Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated overview screen right before path selection to explain different companion journey types.
candidates.why: While initial path conversion is 92.8%, mean time spent is high (514s), indicating users deliberate without full context.

new_path_overview.headline: Explore Pet Path Types
new_path_overview.body: Understand companion styles and journey options before making your selection.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new companion overview screen within the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Path step already converts well (92.8%); adding extra screens typically adds friction and reduces conversion.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Interactive Preview Flow
candidates.change: Add interactive companion audio and visual preview components directly on the pet selection screen.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes median 89s / mean 1017s and has a drop-off of over 21%, benefiting from interactive preview reassurance.

guard.reason: Enhances the pet selection screen with preview and sound components.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has drop-off, but past adoption interactive new flows performed poorly (-7.1%).

candidates.title: Sign In Two Column Split Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured two-column visual split with clear method choices.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent reports regarding account sign-in persistence and missing pets after signing in.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Home Intro Compact Layout
candidates.change: Switch final home intro step to a compact layout for quicker onboarding completion.
candidates.why: Finish conversion is 75.5% with high completion duration (median 395s, mean 5815s), so simplifying layout reduces friction.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro layout, which is explicitly part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has largest drop-off (24.5%); layout changes previously produced strong positive results (+6.4%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Ready System Notification Opt-In
candidates.change: Add an explicit system notification toggle on the waiting screen when custom pet processing completes.
candidates.why: Home stage waiting step has long wait times (mean 2336s), leading users to leave the desktop window inactive.

guard.reason: Adds an explicit notification toggle to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users stuck on long home stage wait times (mean 2336s).

candidates.title: Sign In Account Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in retains pet save data across sessions.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to keep your pet saved safely and prevent pet resets when opening the app again.

guard.reason: Provides an explanatory hint on sign-in regarding account data persistence.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between sign-in drop-off and top support topic (8 emails regarding account reset).

candidates.title: Upload Photo Lighting Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Display photo upload guidance specifying good lighting and high contrast photo requirements.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom results.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos with good contrast for accurate pet rendering.

guard.reason: Adds clear photo lighting guidance hint to the photo upload step.

candidates.score_note: Only minor support mentions (3 tickets), and adoption hint changes historically hurt conversion (-4.7%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Docking Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Enable progress bar and step counter on the waiting screen during desktop companion preparation.
candidates.why: Users wait median 201s / mean 2336s on home wait stage without active progress feedback.

guard.reason: Displays progress indicators on the waiting screen during pet preparation.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait duration with progress feedback; historical wait_info changes yield steady +1.8% lift.

candidates.title: Story Screen Stage Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign story introduction screen into a stage layout focusing on initial pet narrative context.
candidates.why: Story screen redesigns historically yielded successful wins, aiding user engagement before path choice.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen layout while maintaining narrative context.

candidates.score_note: Target step drop-off is low, but choose_path redesigns historically average +1.8% conversion lift.

lessons_next: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted actual impact, while negative or zero forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.9% and -9.0%).
Choose path copy updates (choose_path, copy) hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 8 of 10 tests, despite 2 winning tests (+3.6% and +6.5%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced highly inconsistent results, ranging from strong wins to severe losses.
